title: HOLD-LC-001 synthetic GTS likelihood transcription audit
question: Does a synthetic primary, independent scalar, and hostile-fixture audit validate the finite public GTS likelihood semantics before any event or physical promotion?
method: Run the local NumPy and standard-library harness against a small synthetic counts/background/background-variance/response fixture using a vectorised transcription of the public GTS likelihood path.

Run an independently written scalar implementation of the same declared equations, using stable scalar expm1 evaluation and the source initial-variance convention, and compare the full finite LLR array and marginal statistic.

Mutate one synthetic count by +7.0 and require the finite marginal statistic to move beyond the tooling rejection threshold, then verify that no external event bytes or unavailable GTS dependencies are silently substituted.

Crosswalk the finite audit to the commit-pinned GTS owner candidate and preserve the T-054 forward method, additive T-059 inverse method, owner order, and all continuous/physical/prospective admission firewalls.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Synthetic finite likelihood/LLR transcription only; no event data, response calibration, detector-to-geocenter propagation, continuous timing likelihood, covariance, candidate score, limit or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 P1 code-semantics audit; established T-054/T-059 methods and owner order are unchanged.

source_audit.script_role: Reproducible finite synthetic source-transcription audit; not an execution of the external GTS repository.
source_audit.fixture_role: Tooling test oracle only; the six-channel counts, backgrounds and response matrix are not event measurements.
source_audit.dependency_boundary: NumPy plus Python standard-library math/json/hashlib only; SciPy, Astropy, HEASARC/GDT, event files and response archives are not substituted.

checks.detail: The vectorised transcription returned status 1, a finite 2 by 3 LLR array and marginal LLR 2055.0880465111127 for the synthetic fixture.
The independent scalar implementation matched the primary array and marginal statistic with maximum absolute delta 4.547473508864641e-13, below the 1.0e-9 tooling tolerance.
The hostile mutation counts[0] += 7.0 changed the marginal LLR by 45.68198208603508, above the 1.0e-6 rejection threshold.
The audit completed without external GTS event/template inputs or unavailable dependencies, and the output records that boundary explicitly.
This is an additive finite code audit; T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner ordering, and physical/prospective firewalls are unchanged.

finding: The synthetic harness provides a reproducible finite audit of the public GTS likelihood transcription: primary and independently coded scalar equations agree to 4.547e-13, a hostile count mutation is detected, and the external-dependency boundary is explicit. This advances code-semantics reproducibility only; it does not execute the public repository or admit any event-level, continuous timing, physical, or prospective owner.
decision_reason: A bounded synthetic primary/independent/hostile test was completed against the commit-pinned code semantics, resolving the planned pre-event reproduction checkpoint without importing event data or changing either established research method.
decision_scope: T0 synthetic finite source-code transcription audit only; no event likelihood, response value, dynamic identification, physical identity, empirical prediction, or tier promotion.
assumptions: The public GTS source commit recorded in the parent candidate card remains the code-semantic authority for this transcription audit.
The synthetic fixture is a tooling oracle and does not stand in for GW170817 or any observational sample.
The local estimator, response-owner, Stachie-statistic, and prospective-holdout contracts remain controlling for any later event-level work.
Agreement of two implementations of the same declared finite equations is evidence about transcription correctness, not about the physical adequacy of those equations.
missing_assumptions: A reproducible external GTS environment lock including Python, NumPy, SciPy, Astropy, HEASARC/GDT and exact package versions.
Immutable GW170817 TTE/trigdat/position-history bytes, response-template bytes, detector configuration, and their source hashes.
An event-specific response-validity, gain-calibration, spacecraft-state and detector-to-geocenter uncertainty owner.
A continuous detector timing likelihood, joint covariance and intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law linked to the Stachie joint statistic.
A sealed candidate-neutral prospective holdout and an independently frozen score before target disclosure.

adversarial_review.check: Could matching two local implementations hide a common transcription error relative to the public source?
adversarial_review.disposition: VALID-WITH-MITIGATION: the harness is explicitly a source-transcription audit, records the source commit and parent code-semantics card, and keeps direct source re-audit plus external execution as the next gate.

adversarial_review.check: Could the synthetic fixture be mistaken for an event-level or observational result?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the JSON and exploration mark the fixture as a tooling oracle, include no event identifiers or measurements, and assign no observational credit.

adversarial_review.check: Does one count mutation establish full implementation robustness?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: it demonstrates sensitivity to one hostile mutation only; boundary, dependency, response-index, template, and event-level hostile suites remain open.

adversarial_review.check: Could the NumPy-only harness silently substitute unavailable GTS dependencies or response data?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the dependency boundary is recorded and the harness imports no GTS event/template or unavailable runtime package.

adversarial_review.check: Could finite LLR agreement admit HOLD-LC-001 continuous timing, calibration, or physical ownership?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: finite code semantics do not supply event response validity, detector-to-geocenter propagation, covariance, intrinsic lag, or prospective lock.

adversarial_review.check: Could this audit replace the established T-054 forward or T-059 inverse method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: it is an additive T-061 checkpoint and leaves both methods, owner order, and stopped-loop rules unchanged.

boundary: EXP-001313 is a T0 synthetic finite code-semantics audit. It does not admit a continuous HOLD-LC-001 likelihood, covariance, detector-to-geocenter implementation, response value, calibration-validity rule, intrinsic-lag nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, event candidate, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure, Sector-A closure, or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 reproducible synthetic primary/independent/hostile code audit with source-commit pin; no external repository execution or event-level numerical reproduction
next_action: Freeze the external GTS dependency lock, exact response-template archive, GW170817 input bytes and event configuration before any event execution; then reproduce the finite likelihood and response-index paths in primary, independent and hostile modes. Keep the Stachie joint-linkage, detector-to-geocenter, covariance, intrinsic-lag, prospective, and physical-identity fields locked, while continuing unchanged T-054 owner intake in parallel.
stop_or_redesign: If the external environment, event bytes or response templates cannot be hash-pinned, retain this result as synthetic code provenance and do not admit event-level HOLD-LC-001 ownership.
If external execution disagrees with this transcription, issue a new versioned correction and do not use either path for event scoring until the discrepancy is resolved.
If response indexing, calibration, propagation, covariance or timing ownership remains absent, report finite code evidence only and keep the branch parked at T0.
If an event run requires post hoc parameter or candidate-label choices, invalidate prospective credit and record the leakage as a new exploration.
non_claims: The harness does not execute the external USRA-STI GTS repository and does not establish an event-level GBM result.
The synthetic fixture is not GW170817 data, a calibration measurement, a response value, or a prospective holdout.
Finite primary/independent agreement is not a continuous Delta_t_det likelihood, detector-to-geocenter correction, covariance, intrinsic-lag law, Stachie joint Lambda, or physical owner.
No microscopic dynamics, QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity identity, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything, or mass-gap claim follows.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner order, and stopped-loop rules are unchanged.
